name: Arcane Eye
summary: An invisible, invulnerable floating eye you see through; it moves 30 ft as a Bonus Action.
text: You create an invisible, invulnerable eye that hovers within range for the duration. You receive what it sees, and it can look in every direction at once with Darkvision out to 30 feet. As a Bonus Action you can move it up to 30 feet in any direction. Solid barriers stop it, but it can squeeze through an opening as small as 1 inch across. Concentration, up to 1 hour.
